name: A Scribbled Letter
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, adventurer. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local hunter trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
narrative.objectives: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.
narrative.offerRewardText: Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled champion can give 'em. Good luck.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, ye got me letter, Busch... good.Time was when ye'd not catch a friend dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
